meta.name: algorithmic-art
meta.description: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use this when users request creating art using code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

copy.tagline: 用代码生成视觉艺术作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用代码创作独特的视觉艺术
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create unique visual art with code

howto.what: Claude 会用 p5.js 做算法艺术:先写一份算法美学宣言(.md),再产出单个自包含 HTML 交互作品,靠种子随机数驱动粒子、流场等画面,参数可调,换种子可复现同一结果。
howto.when: 当你要求用代码创作生成艺术、算法艺术,或提到流场等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 p5.js 做一件生成艺术作品,主题是潮汐与噪声
say.note: 先写算法美学宣言,再产出可交互的 HTML 作品

say.text: 把种子换成 2024,重新生成同一件作品
say.note: 同一种子始终得到完全相同的画面

say.text: 给侧栏加一个控制粒子数量的参数滑杆
say.note: 在现有作品上新增一个可调参数控件

howto.what_en: Claude makes algorithmic art with p5.js: it first writes an algorithmic philosophy as a .md file, then outputs one self-contained HTML piece driven by seeded randomness, with tunable parameters and reproducible results per seed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for art made with code, generative or algorithmic art, or mention flow fields and particle systems.

say_en.text: Make a p5.js generative artwork about tides and noise
say_en.note: Writes the philosophy first, then an interactive HTML piece

say_en.text: Change the seed to 2024 and regenerate the same piece
say_en.note: The same seed always reproduces identical output

say_en.text: Add a slider that controls the particle count
say_en.note: Adds one parameter control to the sidebar
